title: T-pillar at Çavuştepe, visited with Robert Schoch
summary: Matt tells of T-pillar at Çavuştepe, visited with Robert Schoch, about recent visit; ancient site at Çavuştepe, Turkey, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: A man named Matt, speaking on a podcast with a host, Jesse Michels, about ancient history, says he recently visited Çavuştepe in Turkey with a researcher named Robert Schoch. He describes a T-shaped stone pillar there that he says is made of basalt, a hard volcanic rock. He raises it as part of a wider argument that something important happened in the distant past, around 12,000 BC.
